title: Shotbox
content:
Since I made Doodle Scan I've had a bunch of ideas of things I can do with image manipulation — it led to me finally doing my favicon generator. The third idea, the tool trilogy if you will, was to replicate a simple version of what CleanShot does — adding a background, padding, and rounding corners to a screenshot.

I have CleanShot but sometimes I'm on my phone or a computer that doesn't have it installed. I like to think I'm pretty good at naming things but this is not one I'm particularly happy with. Regardless, ShotBox is live and does the main thing I use the CleanShot editor for — padding, coloured backgrounds, add shadow, download it as a PNG. Simple.
